picks.headline: "Steam's required AI disclosure is the right move": devs say gen AI should be called out in games
picks.excerpt: Developers back Valve's mandate requiring generative-AI content to be disclosed on Steam store pages, saying gen AI shipped in a game should be flagged to players and wishing every storefront would adopt the same rule.
